snippet.title: Fluffy's Adventure (1995) a Macintosh game
snippet.description:
A cute game made by George Norman in 1995 for macintosh, it appears the game to be for children(Almost lost during play).
This is a shareware and not a full or a complete version.

Played with an emulator called Sheepshaver.
Version of the game 1.2.
